title: CRUD Operations
definition: Create, Read, Update, and Delete. The four basic functions of persistent storage.
simpleExplanation: No matter how complex an application is, it always boils down to CRUD. Facebook? Create a post. Read your feed. Update your profile. Delete a photo. In Node APIs, these directly map to HTTP methods: POST (Create), GET (Read), PUT/PATCH (Update), DELETE (Delete).
realWorldExample: Writing the four core Mongoose queries: `Model.create()`, `Model.find()`, `Model.findByIdAndUpdate()`, and `Model.findByIdAndDelete()`.

intermediate: Which HTTP method maps to the 'U' in CRUD?
